original: !You can not strike with {item:text}.
translation: 你无法用{item}进行攻击。

original: !Both parties manage to hurt each other.
translation: 双方都伤到了对方。

original: +{item:text} hits the ground.
translation: {item}掉到了地上。

original: !You fail to complete your ranged attack!
translation: 你的远程攻击未能完成！

original: !You have no weapon wielded in that hand!
translation: 你那只手上没有装备武器！

original: !You've been attacked from out of sight!
translation: 你遭到了视线之外的攻击！

original: &Your serious leg injuries make it impossible to stay on your feet!
translation: 你的腿伤太重，已经站不住了！

original: :You regain consciousness...
translation: 你恢复了意识……

original: !There's {creature:text} in your way!
translation: {creature}挡住了你的路！

original: !You cannot treat this wound any further now. Try again tomorrow.
translation: 你现在无法再继续治疗这处伤口。请明天再试。

original: &You are not tired!
translation: 你并不疲倦！

original: !This item is not suitable for that!
translation: 这件物品不适合这样使用！

original: !Your both hands are in use! Take off something to wield a new item.
translation: 你双手都在使用中！先卸下一件物品，才能装备新物品。

original: !You aren't wielding anything!
translation: 你手上什么也没拿！

original: !Huh? It's not possible to haft {items:text}!
translation: 嗯？无法给{items}装柄！

original: !This door is already open.
translation: 这扇门已经打开了。

original: !This door is already closed.
translation: 这扇门已经关上了。

original: !This gate is already open.
translation: 这扇栅门已经开了。

original: !This gate is already closed.
translation: 这扇栅门已经关了。

original: !You cannot drop something you are wearing.
translation: 你不能丢下身上穿着的东西。

original: !There's no special way to apply {item:text}.
translation: {item}没有特殊的使用方法。

original: !You are carrying too much! Drop excess items to continue your extensive gathering.
translation: 你带的东西太多了！丢下一些多余物品，才能继续大量采集。

original: +{item:text} is buried in the bog.
translation: {item}陷在泥沼里。

original: {creature:text} withdraws from your way.
translation: {creature}让开了你的去路。

original: {creature:text} gets some distance.
translation: {creature}拉开了距离。

original: _You get no response. Go closer.
translation: 你没有得到回应。再靠近一些。

original: !{creature:text} doesn't respond.
translation: {creature}没有回应。

original: !{creature:text} is startled by your attempt to make a conversation.
translation: {creature}被你搭话的举动吓了一跳。

original: {creature:text} starts talking to you...
translation: {creature}开始和你说话……

original: :{creature:text} is now put on the leash.
translation: {creature}现在被拴上了。

original: !Nay, that won't do. Tie it to a tree instead.
translation: 不行，这样不行。把它拴在树上。

original: !The {item:text} doesn't fly quite that far.
translation: {item}没能飞那么远。

original: +The {item:text} hits the slope in between.
translation: {item}击中了中间的斜坡。

original: !You are in melee range! It's better to strike with your {item:text}, than to throw it.
translation: 已经进入近战距离了！用{item}攻击比把它投出去更好。

original: +You swing your arm back preparing to throw {item:text}.
translation: 你向后摆臂，准备投掷{item}。

original: +You draw your {item:text} and prepare to shoot.
translation: 你拉开{item}，准备射击。

original: +You prepare to fire your {item:text}.
translation: 你准备发射{item}。

original: !There are no items at your feet!
translation: 你脚边没有物品！

original: #You start packing items on {creature:text}.
translation: 你开始把物品装到{creature}上。

original: :You push {item:text} into water and jump aboard.
translation: 你把{item}推入水中，跳上去。

original: #Your {item:text} is overloaded and won't move until you ease the load.
translation: 你的{item}超载了；减轻负载之前，它无法移动。

original: &You sit down, spit in the water and start to angle, dreaming of a huge catch.
translation: 你坐下来，朝水里吐了口唾沫，开始垂钓，幻想着能钓到一大批鱼。

original: &You lower {item:text} into the water and start dragging it to find a fish to scoop in.
translation: 你把{item}放入水中，开始拖动它，寻找可以捞起的鱼。

original: &You prepare to strike your {item:text} at the fish that may approach here.
translation: 你握好{item}，准备刺向游过来的鱼。

original: !This is shallow waters fishing method. It's too deep to fish with {item:text} here.
translation: 这是浅水捕鱼法。这里水太深，无法用{item}捕鱼。

original: You didn't manage to catch any fish.
translation: 你没能捕到鱼。

original: _The catch now awaits at your feet to be picked up.
translation: 渔获就在你的脚边，等你捡起。

original: !There are no nets beside you. Nothing to retrieve.
translation: 你身边没有渔网。没有东西可收。

original: &You start retrieving the net from the water...
translation: 你开始从水中收回渔网……

original: There are no fish in this net.
translation: 网里没有鱼。

original: +That {item:text} is damaged and worn out beyond usable condition.
translation: 那张{item}已经破损，无法继续使用。

original: !Huh? There's no water.
translation: 咦？这里没有水。

original: :You finish eating some of that {item:text}.
translation: 你吃完了部分{item}。

original: =Burp! Your stomach is full.
translation: 嗝！你吃饱了。

original: &You are full and satiated and can't eat more right now!
translation: 你已经饱足，现在吃不下更多东西了！

original: !It's not possible to consume plain {item:text}!
translation: 不能直接食用未加工的{item}！

original: :You begin sneaking, trying to stay hidden and move as quietly as possible.
translation: 你开始潜行，尽量不被发现，并且安静地移动。

original: :You quit hiding and sneaking.
translation: 你停止躲藏和潜行。

original: !You can't hide now as you are clearly seen at this location.
translation: 你现在无法躲藏，因为你在这里明显可见。

original: !You make some noise while trying to sneak.
translation: 你潜行时弄出了声响。

original: !You find nothing to harvest there.
translation: 那里没有可采收的东西。

original: !{item:text} needs to be gathered by harvesting!
translation: 必须收割{item}才能采集！

original: !{item:text} doesn't require harvesting, but is gathered by picking up.
translation: {item}无需收割，直接捡起即可。

original: !To gather the seeds as well you need to harvest {item:text} by using your AGRICULTURE-skill.
translation: 若还要收集种子，你必须使用 AGRICULTURE 技能采收{item}。

original: !To gather the seeds, harvest {item:text} after its flowering period.
translation: 要收集种子，请在{item}花期结束后收割。

original: !{item:text} here is past its flowering period and will not yield flowers.
translation: 这里的{item}已经过了花期，不会再长出花朵。

original: !This {item:text} no longer provides any yield nor carries any usable parts.
translation: 这株{item}已经没有收成，也没有可用的部分。

original: !This early-harvested {item:text} doesn't provide any yield.
translation: 过早采收的{item}不会有任何收成。

original: !This {item:text} doesn't carry usable parts to pick, try to harvest and thresh it.
translation: 这种{item}没有可采摘的有用部分，请尝试收割并脱粒。

original: !The {item:text} here has been picked already!
translation: 这里的{item}已经被采摘过了！

original: Ok. You harvested down {items:text}.
translation: 好了。你采收了{items}。

original: !It's too late to plant {item:text} this year.
translation: 今年种植{item}已经太迟了。

original: =Ok. You planted a patch of {item:text} here. Time will tell how many will sprout.
translation: 完成。你在这里种下了一片{item}。过段时间就知道有多少能发芽了。

original: You don't notice any tracks around here.
translation: 你没有注意到附近有任何足迹。

original: =You find some tracks here.
translation: 你在这里发现了一些踪迹。

original: =You spot some tracks close by.
translation: 你发现附近有一些踪迹。

original: You peer into the water. Your reflection peers back at you.
translation: 你朝水里窥望，水中的倒影也回望着你。

original: You think you see something moving in the depths but then it's gone.
translation: 你觉得深处似乎有什么东西在移动，但转眼就不见了。

original: !That is something you can't pour into a container!
translation: 那东西不能倒进容器里！

original: +Ok, {item:text} will be poured in there.
translation: 好的，{item}会被倒进去。

original: !There's nothing to fill your {item:text} with.
translation: 没有东西可以装进你的{item}。

original: =You fill {item:text} with water.
translation: 你把水装满了{item}。

original: !{creature:text} makes it clear that you are not allowed to milk her.
translation: {creature}明确表示不允许你给她挤奶。

original: !Milk {creature:text}? Nay, think again.
translation: 给{creature}挤奶？不，想都别想。

original: +Alright. Thank you for the milk, {creature:text}.
translation: 好的。谢谢你的奶，{creature}。

original: !It seems {creature:text} can't yield any more milk today.
translation: 看来{creature}今天已经不能再产奶了。

original: !{creature:text} is having a dry period. No milk until the next spring.
translation: {creature}正处于停乳期。要等到下一个春天才有奶。

original: +You empty {item:text} to have it filled again.
translation: 你倒空了{item}，以便再次装满它。

original: !You fail to maintain the quality of {item:text} during this step.
translation: 这一步中，你没能保持{item}的品质。

original: Ok. {item:text} you have will be used.
translation: 好了。将使用你携带的{item}。

original: !You should have the carcass nearby on the ground, one step away at the most.
translation: 地上附近应该有动物尸体，最远不能超过一步。

original: #You finalize cleaning the skin and set it properly in place for curing.
translation: 你完成了清理兽皮的工作，并将它放好以便保存。

original: +The skin is now left to dry completely, after which it will keep for future usage.
translation: 兽皮现在会彻底晾干，之后可以保存待用。

original: #You start to scrape and rinse the skin clean from any remaining flesh and fat.
translation: 你开始刮洗兽皮，清除残留的肉和脂肪。

original: #You start to rub the tanning material on the skin.
translation: 你开始把鞣制材料揉擦到兽皮上。

original: #The skin is now left alone for the tanning material to get working.
translation: 现在将兽皮放在一旁，让鞣制材料发挥作用。

original: #You scrape off the tanning mixture and rinse the skin clean.
translation: 你刮掉鞣制混合物，并把兽皮冲洗干净。

original: #The skin is now left to hang until it's dry enough to continue tanning.
translation: 兽皮现在会悬挂晾晒，直到干燥到可以继续鞣制。

original: #You start softening the skin by pounding, stretching, squeezing and cursing - the final and the most laborious stage of tanning.
translation: 你开始捶打、拉伸、挤压兽皮，还一边咒骂，以此软化兽皮——这是鞣制过程中最后也是最费力的阶段。

original: !The water is too cold for retting! It is not possible now.
translation: 水温太低，无法浸沤！现在不能进行这项操作。

original: #You proceed to start pounding the tendon to separate the sinew fibres.
translation: 你开始敲打筋腱，以分离筋腱纤维。

original: #You proceed to extract fibres from {item:text} simply by hand.
translation: 你接下来直接用手从{item}中抽取纤维。

original: !That is too few! You need at least {items:text} to extract practical amount of fibre.
translation: 数量太少！至少需要{items}，才能提取出实用数量的纤维。

original: #Now you need to break and clean away the stems to release and obtain the fibres.
translation: 现在需要打碎茎秆并清理掉它们，才能释放并取得纤维。

original: +You throw some water on the sauna stove.
translation: 你往桑拿炉上泼了些水。

original: !You should be located near heated sauna stove in order to throw water on it for steam to rise.
translation: 要把水泼到桑拿炉上产生蒸汽，你必须站在已经烧热的桑拿炉附近。

original: !You get no steam out of the sauna stove as the stones are not hot enough.
translation: 石头还不够热，桑拿炉没有产生蒸汽。

original: :The stones aren't too hot but mild steam rises from the sauna stove.
translation: 石头不算太热，但桑拿炉上升起了温和的蒸汽。

original: :The sauna oven hisses and hot steam rises and fills the room.
translation: 桑拿炉发出嘶嘶声，热蒸汽升起并弥漫整个房间。

original: :The water here is shallow enough to wade.
translation: 这里的水够浅，可以涉水通过。

original: !It's deep water there! You need to swim, or go by watercraft.
translation: 那里水很深！你得游过去，或乘船前往。

original: :You get out of the water.
translation: 你上了岸。

original: :It smells like {item:text} is ready.
translation: 闻起来{item}已经做好了。

original: :It smells like {item:text} is burning soon.
translation: 闻起来{item}快要烧焦了。

original: !It's not possible to grind {items:text} for flour.
translation: 不能把{items}磨成面粉。

original: You do know that's {item:text}.
translation: 你知道那是{item}。

original: =You recognize that being {item:text}.
translation: 你认出这是{item}。

original: =You reckon it must be {item:text}.
translation: 你觉得那一定是{item}。

original: =You have learned something new about {item:text}.
translation: 你对{item}有了新的认识。

original: You do not recognize what {item:text} might be.
translation: 你认不出{item}是什么。

original: _It's impossible for you to repair {item:text}.
translation: {item}无法修理。

original: !You are already wearing that.
translation: 你已经穿着那件东西了。

original: !You cannot wear double {item:text}.
translation: 你不能同时穿戴两件{item}。

original: !Nay, not that one! You are supposed to take off things you are wearing or items you are wielding.
translation: 不行，不是那个！你应该脱下身上穿着的衣物，或放下手中拿着的物品。

original: +You take off your {item:text}.
translation: 你脱下了{item}。

original: #Whoa, items all over the place! Hoard wisely and spread your stuff over a larger area.
translation: 哇，到处都是物品！留心存放位置，把东西分散开。

original: !Huh? There's no creature there.
translation: 咦？那里没有生物。

original: :Meanwhile, {creature:text} enters your view...
translation: 与此同时，{creature}进入了你的视野……

original: !Meanwhile, an aggressive {creature:text} enters your view...
translation: 与此同时，一只具有攻击性的{creature}进入了你的视野……

original: !Meanwhile, an aggressive {creature:text} approaches...
translation: 与此同时，一只具有攻击性的{creature}正在靠近……

original: !Meanwhile, {creature:text} turns hostile on you...
translation: 与此同时，{creature}开始对你怀有敌意……

original: You managed to make a fire.
translation: 你成功生起了火。

original: You did not succeed in making a fire.
translation: 你没能生起火。

original: !More firewood is required there.
translation: 那里需要更多柴火。

original: !Some smaller kindling such as branches is required there.
translation: 这里需要一些较小的引火物，例如树枝。

original: !More kindling such as branches is required there.
translation: 那里还需要树枝等更多引火物。

original: +You put out {item:text}.
translation: 你熄灭了{item}。

original: +You gently set {item:text} on the ground as a sacrifice.
translation: 你轻轻地把{item}作为祭品放在地上。
